---
title: "Why the RAAF is Years Ahead of the USAF"

The Royal Australian Air Force is a good [seven years ahead](http://www.abc.net.au/news/newsitems/200205/s557139.htm "seven years ahead") of the US when it comes to scaring office workers with low altitude photo shoots.
